final: SELECT oc.account_id, d.A3 as region, oc.order_count, (oc.order_count - ao.avg_count) as difference FROM (SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) as order_count FROM "order" GROUP BY account_id) oc CROSS JOIN (SELECT AVG(order_count) as avg_count FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) as order_count FROM "order" GROUP BY account_id)) ao JOIN account a ON oc.account_id = a.account_id JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id ORDER BY difference DESC, account_id ASC LIMIT 10
